data: Apple's net income was $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022 (the year ended September 24, 2022) and $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024). That works out to a decline of about $6.1 billion, or roughly 6.1%. The fiscal 2024 figure was held down by a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion related to the European Commission State Aid decision; excluding that charge, net income would have been higher than in fiscal 2022.
